analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($325.92) above SMA5 ($322.13), below SMA20 ($344.08): indicating short-term weakness and medium-term weakness.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($399.88) and SMA200 ($393.84): signaling long-term trend weakening.
· 52-week position (13.9%) + current price near 52-week low ($301.43).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (36.2→40.7): Exited oversold and maintaining neutral territory, showing a weak attempt at recovery.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.9773→-0.5386): Worsening within negative territory, maintaining a bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $344.08): Consolidating around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($324.27): Price level adjacent to the 52-week low.
· Swing Resistance ($330.79): First resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: Range-bound phase, no clear Higher Low or Lower High identified.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.36x): Subdued compared to the 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase): Lack of clear direction, meeting conditions for a wait-and-see approach.
